## Objective
- Make three changes to the MTD quiz prototype: (1) switch from a modal box to full-screen with normal page scroll (no inner scroll container), (2) apply the original site's link states (default/hover/focus-visible/active) to all quiz links including "Previous", (3) apply the original site's button and option-card states (default/hover/pressed/focus) on shared classes.

## Important Details
- Repo: `sage-prototypes`; serve root with `python3 -m http.server 8150`, open `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`
- Quiz runs inside an **iframe**; generated by `build-variants.js` from an HTML source template
- Styles live in `quiz-page.css` and `variant-quiz-figma.css`
- Reference site for states: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`
- Constraint: no inner scroll container; states set **once on the shared class**, never per instance
- Follow the repo's link guideline
- Keep change minimal, no unrelated file edits, no debug code, **do not commit**
- Playwright available in `node_modules` for browser verification
- `start-card.py` not found at `~/.agents/bin/start-card.py` (session init script missing)

- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` – target quiz page to modify (or rebuild)
- `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` – generates variant-a from the source template
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html` – source HTML template for the quiz

Product UI as HTML into a file path: measure the host ancestors' boxes before editing; a wrapper with `overflow:hidden` clips below content, and element screenshots never catch it.

Product UI as HTML from a node inside a component set: `figma-shot.js` cannot export there (the transport append is rejected) — measure live `get_design_context` geometry instead of the SVG pattern.

Product UI as HTML for a tab pane's picture: a raster pane inside a PNGs-only pattern takes live HTML only as a recorded deviation (the hero media-slot precedent — no SVG either way), and its 2x measure comes from `download_assets --defaultScale 2`; `get_screenshot` answers 1x for that vector node whatever `maxDimension` says, so sizing off it reads every small role a size short. A mounted art is only "as created" if the pane gives it the width it was drawn at — the kit's 58.33% media slot (568 of a 994 pane) ran the tax summary on its three-column rung while its card shows five, so the pane sizes the art to ONE box (max 640, min 360, 500 tall) and the copy takes the remainder at a measured floor (292: at 290 the body cuts "built-in"); a 500-tall frame is not a 500-tall picture — the guide's own air inside it leaves the art at 417/460 and three tabs read smaller than the other two, so the air is zeroed and the art drawn at the box; and a box narrower than an art's mount air (Cleanup's 612 + 24/24 = 660.1) fires that art's rung and lets the dialog cover a radio, so that one pane keeps its column and draws a 640 stage inside it.

Product UI as HTML whose SVG 403s: the shipped `@2x` raster is then the measure source, and its edges are a downscale blend — size type off the measured cap height, never an assumed em ratio (0.72 read the whole small-text ramp a size small), and report the interior agreement rather than chasing its outermost 1px.

Product UI as HTML from a supplied screenshot: the bitmap's black or grey matte is capture surface, not product UI — take the art bounds from the window edges, derive the floor from the narrowest label's ink run and its browser width at 1px (a 2× cap-height read includes descenders and sizes the whole ramp too large), and put the page's backdrop behind the windows rather than repainting the matte. At the smallest rung the rows must feed ONE grid (a per-row `max-content` label track steps every value sideways), the divider belongs to the fieldset's right edge rather than the window's, and the 360 floor's body air leaves at ≤375 — otherwise the scroller engages at 360 itself. A two-window picture keeps both windows as two overlaid surfaces at a phone width — the front right-flush over the back, both front edges right of the back's, never one flow column or one merged surface — and the back window keeps its source width ratio and its FULL body — only its WIDTH scales with the art: its copy, its controls and its body length keep the source's own size at every width, the same absolute type the dialog is frozen at, so its header drops its " - Select Record Type" suffix (a declared rung at a 440px stage, where the full string needs 423) instead of wrapping or shrinking, and the dialog's top edge sits at one fixed offset because nothing above it moves (a scaled glyph put the radios on 6.99px; freezing the type while the box shrinks makes a wide title strip with a giant title, not the same window; shrinking the type to the floor makes a 10px title under a 15.49px one; scaling the HEIGHT makes a shorter window, and the scale here is the horizontal space only); hiding its radios is the wrong rung. A balance row keeps the source's shape — label on the left, both numbers beside it on the `Balance:` line — because putting the label above its numbers wraps a value the source never wraps.

A product-UI variant of a shipped art (a second composition, a 10px floor, a scale) is the frame's arithmetic, and a screenshot cannot show it: run `node tooling/floor-check.js` — canvas 500, smallest type, one card gutter, the table's seat on its footer, the chart's clearance, the composition, at 29 widths in both switch states. A chart whose height is paid twice breaks the frame first: the 1.2× pie that fitted one aged card was a 508 canvas once the two were stacked, and a 137 donut was a 533 canvas at every width past 730 while every gate the page had still passed (2026-10-17).

Product UI as HTML, ruled cuts: scope cuts by media × container (`@media (max-width: 1079px) { @container (max-width: 559px) { … } }`) — a slot-width-only cut list fires on 1180–1420 laptop slots and hides card titles on desktops; pin the ruled height in the media block, never inside the pane's own `@container` (dead CSS — computed `0px` everywhere), and gate `scrollWidth == clientWidth` at phone widths (an art with a nowrap title needs `container-type: inline-size` to follow its slot; `min-width: 0` does not lower an intrinsic contribution).

Product UI as an animation: a piece that already exists as component HTML/CSS fills no raster slots — copy it verbatim and carry the page bundle's faces, line-height and box-sizing, or the art renders 7.4px short with fallback glyphs.

Page chrome: the same symptom on two pages, or a bug only on the deployed page, is not a folder edit. Run `node tooling/audit-live-comments.js` first. A missing column is a migration — sweep it per `docs/SUPABASE-APPLY.md`, and a re-run of one must be a no-op: a `create policy` without its own `drop policy if exists` aborts the whole Studio batch (42710) — `20261014130000` carried one until 2026-10-16. Paste-success is the editor's opinion; the deployed page's console going quiet is the after-apply proof, and it is scripted now: `node tooling/verify-live-doors.js`, `node tooling/verify-live-responsive.js`, `node tooling/verify-live-cpp-paths.js`, plus the write path's `node tooling/verify-write-roundtrip.js` (refused → stamped → resolved → deleted, nothing left behind). A live gate aimed at the page the change did not touch is not evidence about the page that shipped: `verify-live-responsive.js` opened only the unchanged vendor page and passed 12/12 while customer-payment-services scrolled sideways at 390px — it walks both CPP pages now, and a gated page hides its panes, so `render-check.js` strips the lock the way `check-tab-email.js` does. A migration cannot enable a dashboard hook: applying `15120000`'s function changes nothing until Authentication → Hooks → Before user created points at it — enable it (2026-10-16) and prove it with a real non-Sage sign-up, which must return `403` before any account exists (`node tooling/verify-signup-hook.js`). `node tooling/verify-page-comments.js` never loads `main.css`. A code changed in one place drifts the others. A tool the docs name is not evidence it runs: `add-pair.js` still rewrote a source array two weeks after the pairs moved into `quick_signin_accounts` (fixed 2026-10-16); it needs the service key and is the only thing that also moves the bot's auth password. A tool that measures the deployed page needs both doors: `audit-live-comments.js` carries the passcode cookie and a @sage.com stub session — without them it measures the sign-in shell and times out, which is exactly what the server door (2026-10-15) did to it for a day. A sweep must not reset a pair: the seeds insert only when the row is absent and self-test against the code the row holds — `do update set code` drove a rotated code back to the committed default on every re-run (fixed 2026-10-16).

A deployed old-tree folder URL 404s while its no-slash sibling redirects: trailing-slash normalisation runs before the redirect rules, so `:path*` never matches a URL that ends in a slash. The fix is the explicit rule pair plus the `middleware.js` backstop, not a wider wildcard. A case mismatch between macOS and Linux (e.g. Ongoing_project vs ongoing_project from .gitignore) 404s all child pages on Vercel: keep .gitignore rules lowercase and resolve casing dynamically in `middleware.js`.

A red `node tooling/build-node-index.js --check` is not cleared by regenerating. The parser reads the cpp block and the first table in `ongoing_project/cpp/MAP.md`.

1: /* Keep the embedded quiz flush with its own content so the iframe never grows
2:    an inner scrollbar. Same-origin static hosting: read the document height and
3:    follow the quiz's own screen-change event. Under file:// the read is blocked
4:    by the browser's opaque origin; the CSS min-height then keeps the frame
5:    usable. */
6: (function () {
7:   var frame = document.getElementById("mtd-quiz-frame");
8:   if (!frame) return;
9:   var timer = 0;
10: 
11:   function fit() {
12:     try {
13:       var doc = frame.contentDocument;
14:       if (!doc || !doc.documentElement) return;
15:       var height = Math.max(
16:         doc.documentElement.scrollHeight,
17:         doc.body ? doc.body.scrollHeight : 0,
18:         640
19:       );
20:       if (height > 0) {
21:         var next = Math.ceil(height);
22:         if (Math.abs(frame.getBoundingClientRect().height - next) > 1) {
23:           frame.style.height = next + "px";
24:         }
25:       }
26:     } catch (error) {
27:       /* file:// opaque origin: leave the CSS min-height in place */
28:     }
29:   }
30: 
31:   function soon() {
32:     window.clearTimeout(timer);
33:     timer = window.setTimeout(fit, 50);
34:   }
35: 
36:   function watch() {
37:     fit();
38:     window.setTimeout(fit, 300);
39:     window.setTimeout(fit, 1200);
40:     try {
41:       var win = frame.contentWindow;
42:       var doc = frame.contentDocument;
43:       if (!win || !doc || win.__mtdHeightWatch) return;
44:       win.__mtdHeightWatch = true;
45:       win.addEventListener("mtd-quiz:event", soon);
46:       var observer = new MutationObserver(soon);
47:       observer.observe(doc.documentElement, {
48:         subtree: true,
49:         childList: true,
50:         attributes: true,
51:         characterData: true,
52:       });
53:       if (window.ResizeObserver) {
54:         new ResizeObserver(soon).observe(doc.body || doc.documentElement);
55:       }
56:     } catch (error) {
57:       /* file:// opaque origin */
58:     }
59:   }
60: 
61:   frame.addEventListener("load", watch);
62:   window.setInterval(fit, 250);
63:   window.addEventListener("resize", soon);
64: })();

## Objective
- Make three changes to the MTD quiz prototype: (1) switch from a modal box to full-screen with normal page scroll (no inner scroll container), (2) apply the original site's link states (default/hover/focus-visible/active) to all quiz links including "Previous", (3) apply the original site's button and option-card states (default/hover/pressed/focus) on shared classes.

## Important Details
- Repo root: `/content/bakeoff/quizrepo`; serve with `python3 -m http.server 8150`, open `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`
- **Architecture**: Quiz UI is a compiled React/Figma Make app in an iframe (`quiz/index.html` → `assets/index-DhlXhpMI.js` + `assets/index-NZKFqOaV.css`). Parent page provides modal wrapper and iframe sizing.
- **Style injection**: `variant-quiz.js` injects `variant-quiz-figma.css` into the same-origin iframe, targeting stable class tokens (`Questions-styles__*`; styled-components suffixes: `fGtfKe / kyStRA / hnTQsX / lScyZ / hSoqJU / eAvKFB / hePGzN / jroPAt / kwDpZY / gomnIV / hntNzi`). Bundle is minified and byte-frozen.
- `variant-quiz-figma.css` is currently "Variant A modal only" — state changes must work across both variants.
- `quiz/assets/index-NZKFqOaV.css` (40 KB, 2 lines): **Tailwind CSS v4.3.3** — contains custom properties and a few explicit state rules, but NOT the full set of link/button states (those live in styled-components runtime or parent `main.css`).
- **Extracted state values from quiz CSS so far**:
  - `:root { --quiz-tile-background: var(--mode-color-generic-bg-inverse-faint); --quiz-tile-hover: var(--quiz-background) }`
  - `:root { --quiz-tile-hover: color-mix(in srgb, var(--quiz-background) 65%, transparent) }` (darker mode override)
  - `.solution-finder-host button:focus-visible, .solution-finder-host a:focus-visible { outline: var(--global-borderwidth-m) solid var(--mode-color-action-focus-inverse-default); outline-offset: var(--global-space-comp-xs) }`
  - `--global-borderwidth-m = 3px`
  - `:-moz-focusring:where(:not(iframe)) { outline: auto }`
- **Not yet found**: explicit `:hover`, `:active`, `:link`/`:visited` color/transition values for links and buttons — likely in `main.css` (2.1 MB, parent page Sage design tokens) or styled-components runtime in the JS bundle
- JS bundle search for `StyledLink|StyledBack|StyledButton` returned no hits; `quiz-tile-hover` class was referenced once
- `build-variants.js`: ONE SOURCE (`mtd-income-tax/index.html`), TWO OUTPUTS (`variant-a/`, `variant-b/`); every patch asserts its anchor exactly once; `--check` flag for staleness
- `skills/shared/states.md`: "Write rest, hover, focus, and active before editing any of them."
- `ROUTE.md` search rules: `node` cell → run command only; `none` → open named file; two matching rows → stop and ask
- Constraints: no inner scroll container; states set once on shared class; keep changes minimal; no unrelated file edits; no debug code; **do not commit**
- Playwright available in `node_modules` for browser verification
- Reference site: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html` (same React app as local `quiz/` copy)

## Work State
### Completed
- Read `skills/shared/states.md`, `MAP.md`, `ROUTE.md`, `build-variants.js`
- Read `quiz-modal.js`, `quiz-frame.js`, `quiz-page.css`, `variant-quiz.js`, `variant-quiz-figma.css` (partial)
- Confirmed quiz content lives in compiled React bundle, NOT parent HTML/CSS

A mounted art is only "as created" if the pane gives it the width it was drawn at — the kit's 58.33% media slot (568 of a 994 pane) ran the tax summary on its three-column rung while its card shows five, so the pane sizes the art to ONE box (max 640, min 360, 500 tall) and the copy takes the remainder at a measured floor (292: at 290 the body cuts "built-in"); a 500-tall frame is not a 500-tall picture — the guide's own air inside it leaves the art at 417/460 and three tabs read smaller than the other two, so the air is zeroed and the art drawn at the box; and a box narrower than an art's mount air (Cleanup's 612 + 24/24 = 660.1) fires that art's rung and lets the dialog cover a radio, so that one pane keeps its column and draws a 640 stage inside it.

Product UI as HTML whose SVG 403s: the shipped `@2x` raster is then the measure source, and its edges are a downscale blend — size type off the measured cap height, never an assumed em ratio (0.72 read the whole small-text ramp a size small), and report the interior agreement rather than chasing its outermost 1px.

Product UI as HTML from a supplied screenshot: the bitmap's black or grey matte is capture surface, not product UI — take the art bounds from the window edges, derive the floor from the narrowest label's ink run and its browser width at 1px (a 2× cap-height read includes descenders and sizes the whole ramp too large), and put the page's backdrop behind the windows rather than repainting the matte. At the smallest rung the rows must feed ONE grid (a per-row `max-content` label track steps every value sideways), the divider belongs to the fieldset's right edge rather than the window's, and the 360 floor's body air leaves at ≤375 — otherwise the scroller engages at 360 itself. A two-window picture keeps both windows as two overlaid surfaces at a phone width — the front right-flush over the back, both front edges right of the back's, never one flow column or one merged surface — and the back window keeps its source width ratio and its FULL body — only its WIDTH scales with the art: its copy, its controls and its body length keep the source's own size at every width, the same absolute type the dialog is frozen at, so its header drops its " - Select Record Type" suffix (a declared rung at a 440px stage, where the full string needs 423) instead of wrapping or shrinking, and the dialog's top edge sits at one fixed offset because nothing above it moves (a scaled glyph put the radios on 6.99px; freezing the type while the box shrinks makes a wide title strip with a giant title, not the same window; shrinking the type to the floor makes a 10px title under a 15.49px one; scaling the HEIGHT makes a shorter window, and the scale here is the horizontal space only); hiding its radios is the wrong rung. A balance row keeps the source's shape — label on the left, both numbers beside it on the `Balance:` line — because putting the label above its numbers wraps a value the source never wraps.

A product-UI variant of a shipped art (a second composition, a 10px floor, a scale) is the frame's arithmetic, and a screenshot cannot show it: run `node tooling/floor-check.js` — canvas 500, smallest type, one card gutter, the table's seat on its footer, the chart's clearance, the composition, at 29 widths in both switch states. Product UI as an animation: a piece that already exists as component HTML/CSS fills no raster slots — copy it verbatim and carry the page bundle's faces, line-height and box-sizing, or the art renders 7.4px short with fallback glyphs.

Page chrome: the same symptom on two pages, or a bug only on the deployed page, is not a folder edit. Run `node tooling/audit-live-comments.js` first.
